Theme

Themes allow you to customize the visual appearance of your business documents such as invoices, quotes, statements, and other forms.

Each theme contains HTML and CSS code that controls the layout, colors, fonts, and overall design of documents when they are printed or emailed to customers and suppliers.

Using Themes

After creating a theme, you can select it when customizing individual forms under the Settings tab. Different forms can use different themes to match your branding needs.

Themes use the Liquid templating language, which allows you to include dynamic content from your transactions while maintaining consistent formatting.

Name

Enter a name for this theme. This identifies the theme when selecting it for forms or reports.

Use descriptive names like 'Modern Invoice' or 'Classic Statement' to easily identify the theme's purpose.

Template

Enter the HTML/CSS template code. This controls the visual appearance and layout of documents using this theme.

Themes use Liquid templating language with HTML and CSS to customize how transactions appear when printed or emailed.

Inactive

Check this box to deactivate the theme. Inactive themes won't appear in selection lists but remain in existing documents.

Deactivate outdated themes instead of deleting them to preserve the formatting of historical documents.
